n48be1db158.summary: Data from the National Association of Home Builders indicates that U.S. homebuilder pessimism has reached high levels amid ongoing deterioration in the American housing market.

n6e7551f3a6.summary: The average long-term US mortgage rate fell to 7.32% in the first pullback in two months, while home purchase mortgage applications dropped 7% as high costs persisted.
